cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Everything Is a Contest
cards.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I want potatoes; you want pizza. First to peel five chooses. I've done four.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order pizza unless you can find a cheaper dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Potatoes cost nothing. They're already here. I win.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got a voucher. Pizza's free.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then best free dinner wins. I'll cook potatoes, you order pizza, and Mum can judge. She always asks for my potatoes.

mechanism: A uses culinary judging criteria as the supposedly only qualified cook to turn dinner disagreements into competitions A can win.
confusable: Mere menu preference lacks comparative victory; A must keep changing the winning criterion as B supplies a competing advantage.
comparison: Tea alternative turns timing and consumption into technical judging; dinner scene uses cost then quality.
seedUse: Potato/pizza free voucher seed comes from D19-a; S03 gives trained evaluation and comparable-entry rules rather than professional slogans.
